mechanism: Allopurinol may increase chloroquine levels by inhibiting hepatic metabolism and competing for renal clearance, while chloroquine may increase allopurinol levels through similar mechanisms, potentially increasing toxicity of both agents.
action: Monitor for signs of chloroquine toxicity (visual disturbances, myopathy, cardiac arrhythmias) and allopurinol toxicity (rash, hepatotoxicity); consider dose adjustments or increased monitoring intervals if concurrent use is necessary.
